trust_decision.summary: Whether the model checkpoint file named by the inference config (ckpt_path) may run code when unpickled; decided only by the torch.load call in create_pipeline, which at the pinned commit already uses weights_only=True inside a safe_globals block.

landing_point.why: The summary names create_pipeline; it holds the only torch.load of the user-supplied ckpt_path.

fix_sites.entry_point: inference.py CLI (--inference_config YAML ckpt_path, inference.py:90-91) and the Cog predictor setup/predict (predict.py:85, predict.py:189)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix diff changes one site only (fix.diff:9-20); it is a torch-version compatibility shim, not a scope extension.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: PoseNet.from_pretrained (mimicmotion/modules/pose_net.py:68-80) has no caller in the repo, so a solver can call it unused/legacy and outside the create_pipeline report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Loading the legitimate MimicMotion state_dict (unet/vae/image_encoder/pose_net tensors) with strict=False and the prefix-warning loop must keep working; on old torch without safe_globals the load must still succeed (the very purpose of the fix commit).

O6_input_shapes: single checkpoint file path from config (ckpt_path); no other shapes handled

O7_producer.where: inference.py:90 (OmegaConf.load of the inference YAML supplying ckpt_path); predict.py:77-82 (OmegaConf.create with fixed paths)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PoseNet.from_pretrained unpickles a caller-supplied weights file with torch.load and no weights_only, a second load of the same model family's checkpoints.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: No caller anywhere in the repo; create_pipeline builds PoseNet directly (mimicmotion/utils/loader.py:33) and the report names only create_pipeline.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and package (mimicmotion/modules vs mimicmotion/utils), one import away (mimicmotion/utils/loader.py:10)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An optional separate UNet/pose-net weights override loaded with torch.load from a config key.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The unet is built from_config with no weights, and maintainers often add a per-component ckpt override next to the combined checkpoint.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A user-selectable custom checkpoint path/URL input on the Cog predictor that reaches a load helper outside create_pipeline.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The predictor already switches checkpoints per request; accepting a custom one is a natural feature request.

O9_family: insecure deserialization (CWE-502, torch.load/pickle of model checkpoint)

O10_build.toolchain: conda/pip per environment.yaml and cog.yaml (torch, diffusers, transformers, onnxruntime, omegaconf)
O10_build.project_tests: none; the repository contains no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add weights_only=True to the create_pipeline torch.load and stop, which is already the state of the pinned commit.

out_of_scope_notes: Base SVD components load through diffusers/transformers from_pretrained (mimicmotion/utils/loader.py:24-31); library code, not pursued.
DWPose ONNX models load through onnxruntime InferenceSession (mimicmotion/dwpose/wholebody.py:15-18); different format, not pursued.
